name: @pipeworx/mcp-cia-factbook

tools.name: factbook_country
tools.description: CIA World Factbook country profile (final 2026 edition): background history, geography, population and demographics, ethnic groups, languages, religions, government type, capital, constitution, legal system, executive and legislative branches, economy (GDP, growth, inflation, exports, imports, debt), energy, military, transnational issues. Use for "tell me about Kenya", "what type of government does Chile have", "Factbook profile of Vietnam". Accepts a country or territory name, an ISO code, or "gec:<code>". Returns the five core sections by default; pass sections to choose others or "all".

country.description: Country or territory name ("Kenya", "South Korea", "Greenland"), ISO 3166 code ("KE", "KOR"), or a Factbook code as "gec:ke".

sections.description: Sections to return. Default: Introduction, Geography, People and Society, Government, Economy. Others: Environment, Energy, Communications, Transportation, Military and Security, Space, Terrorism, Transnational Issues. ["all"] returns every section (~35 KB).

tools.name: factbook_compare
tools.description: Compare CIA World Factbook fields side by side across up to 10 countries — population, median age, life expectancy, real GDP per capita, GDP growth, inflation, unemployment, public debt, military expenditures, area, internet users, etc. Use for "compare population and GDP per capita of Kenya, Nigeria and Ghana" or "life expectancy in Japan vs Germany". Field names match the Factbook headings (case-insensitive, partial match allowed; "Economy > Exports" pins a section). factbook_fields lists the exact names.

countries.description: Two to ten country names or ISO codes, e.g. ["Kenya", "Nigeria", "Ghana"].

fields.description: Factbook field names, e.g. ["Population", "Real GDP per capita", "Life expectancy at birth"]. Max 10.

tools.name: factbook_fields
tools.description: List the sections and field names the CIA World Factbook carries for a country (e.g. Economy → "Real GDP per capita", "Inflation rate (consumer prices)", "Exports - partners"). Use before factbook_compare to find the exact field to ask for. Defaults to the United States profile, which carries the full field set.

country.description: Country name or ISO code. Default "United States".

tools.name: factbook_entities
tools.description: List or search the 261 entities in the CIA World Factbook — sovereign countries, dependencies and territories, the oceans, the European Union and the World — with their Factbook (GEC) codes and regions. Use to find how the Factbook names a place ("Burma", "Congo (Brazzaville)", "DRC") or to list every entity in a region such as africa or central-america-n-caribbean.

query.description: Name substring to search, e.g. "guinea" or "island". Omit to list all.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-cia-factbook forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the cia-factbook pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
